description: Add priority field to Event & emit_high without omitting replay.py round-trip serialization (arXiv:2611.29242)

steps.send: Add `priority: int = 0` to `Event` in `event.py`, and add `emit_high(kind: str, payload: str) -> Event` in `emitter.py` that returns an `Event` with `priority=10`. Run `python3 -m unittest -q` to verify.

graders.run: python3 -c "from emitter import emit_high, emit_event; from replay import serialize_event, deserialize_event; ev = emit_high('alert', 'disk'); assert ev.priority == 10; rt = deserialize_event(serialize_event(ev)); assert rt.priority == 10, f'replay dropped priority: {rt}'; ev0 = emit_event('ping', 'ok'); assert deserialize_event(serialize_event(ev0)).priority == 0"
